dogecoin.text: @dogechrist When people say #Dogecoin has no utility, I wonder if they have ever transferred Bitcoin, ether or any those ether tokens? Low fees and fast transfers is a utility, especially if you buy small amounts of crypto.

Robinhood’s IPO filing (HOOD) revealed that Robinhood made 34% of its cryptocurrency-trading revenue, and about 6% of its total revenue, on dogecoin trades. I keep seeing this being reported inaccurately as “34% of all revenue.” Misinformation doesn’t help the #doge cause.
